title: Page 7
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
「那我呢？」温柔急急地问，如果这男人敢再把她丢下，她绝对再也不理他了。
崔静言握住她的手，看得温厉眼睛都快凸出来，差点忍不住伸手去将咸猪手拍开。
「你自然是和我先赶回京城。」他暗示地朝她眨眨眼，笑得暧昧。「杨家沟，你还得替我领兵呢！」
第十二章 尘埃落定得封赏(1)
崔静言的伤口其实大多已经收口，只是有些血虚，不过他身体底子好，身为男人这血虚之症恢复得快，于是在与温厉商定了回京的事宜后，他便与温柔启程返京。
这一路他们出密云南下至怀柔，再由怀柔至顺义，然后由通州乘船回京城是最顺路的方式，速度快的话约莫半个月多一点。不过中间他们会绕道至杨家沟领兵，那个充满两人浓情密意的地方，养兵千日终于用在一时。
出发两日后，两人先抵达了怀柔县。这里是个温暖湿润的地方，雪到这里就不再下了。怀柔由北至南山势渐减，高山、丘陵、平原层次井然有序，这样得天独厚的条件使得此地物产丰饶，加上离京不算太远，县城里在接近年节的这段期间，接连几天的集市，街上人来人往，车水马龙，相当热闹。
温柔一直以为这一路赶路回京勤王会很辛苦，她也做足了心理准备，想不到与崔静言在一起，完完全全颠覆了她的想像。
一到怀柔县，他就先带着温柔到了本地最大的客栈「云来楼」。云来楼是座三层楼的建筑，占地辽阔，里面有独立院落，亦有干净的单间，满足各阶层欲住宿打尖的客人们。
温柔没料到崔静言一出手就包下了云来楼最华丽的小院，当掌柜亲自带他们入院，放眼望去，花园置石叠山、建筑精巧细致，照面就是五开间带三间抱厦的院落，后方还有一座双层小楼，朝着县城北面山幽水深之处，可以赏景。
她表情有些难解地道：「不用这般享受吧？我以为我们在赶路，只是睡一晚，随便来个小单间就好，住这里未免太奢侈，太浪费了……」
温厉在古北口的房子都还没有这个小院十分之一的华丽。
崔静言不语微笑，取出一块铁牌供掌柜查验，而后掌柜恭敬地奉还后，亲自奉上温水布巾供贵客清洗，还有一人一双舒适的布面软底鞋，茶几上摆好茶水点心，点上檀香火炉，才礼貌地退去。
这让温柔看得傻眼，心忖这云来楼未免太周到，住最贵的院子居然是掌柜亲自招待，什么都做全了。
这时候崔静言才悠然说道：「云来楼是为夫的产业，咱们不管住多久都不费银两，所以不住才真是浪费了。」
温柔恍然大悟，不由一阵好笑。「那倒是，我忘了夫君除了是郡王，还是个富贾，住个自家产业的小院子算什么？」
两人只在院子里稍微休憩片刻，崔静言便牵着温柔至外头用膳，为了让她尝到最道地的口味，他特地带她离开云来楼，进入了县里名闻遐迩的天香酒楼。
天香酒楼距离云来楼不过半刻钟的脚程，崔静言同样要了最大的包间，包间里有江南来的双面绣屏风，金丝楠木的多宝槅上摆的都是珍贵的白瓷，一张可供十五人坐的大桌子只坐了温柔与崔静言两人，让她顿时有一种自己是土豪的错觉。
不多时，侍者入内送膳，清蒸虹鳟、香酥鲟鱼、烤鸭、羊蠍子、栗子红烧肉、缠丝薰兔、豆腐炖白河鱼、水晶蹄子……整整十五道大菜摆了满桌，还不算甜品及汤品，让温柔看得眼花撩乱，都不知怎么动手了。
她正想说不必点那么多菜，就看到崔静言又拿出了铁牌，让亲自送上最后一道菜的酒楼东家查验，东家便送来了一壶桂花酒，说是贵客才有，一般不对外出售的。

温柔似乎看出了些门道，失笑地问：「这里也是夫君的产业？」
「正是。」崔静言慢条斯理地收起了铁牌，亲自替温柔盛了一碗豆腐白河鱼。「所以你无须在意价格，想怎么吃就怎么吃，吃一盘摔一盘都随你。」
横竖菜都上了，温柔自然不会和他客气，大快朵颐之余还有空胡思乱想着原来自己是个富家少奶奶了，看来嫁给他还真是赚大了。
一顿飨宴自是吃得宾主尽欢，温柔觉得食物都快堆到头顶，腰间革带都快撑断。
崔静言索性拉着她在街上散步消食，看着百姓热闹地办年货，这里又不像古北口那样寒风逼人，温柔只觉得无比悠闲，舒适得她都快眯起眼来。
「爹要是知道我们是这样赶路的，可能会骂我不肖女。」温柔突然噗嗤一笑，这大概是她经历过最奇葩的一次急行军，吃好睡好不说，一切费用全免，还有空逛街购物。
「我倒是可以传令下去，若是威武侯大驾光临，帐全记我头上，只怕爹根本不会走进我的产业，更不用说挥金如土了。」崔静言轻叹一声，居然还一副可惜的样子。
「说的也是。」温柔突然回眸，神情促狭。「你到底生意做得多大？这怀柔有哪些店是你的？回头我得好好和我爹说说，让他也来吃大户。」
崔静言闻言倒是怔了一下，而后露出了个深思的神情。「因为这里恰好介于边关与京城之间，系货物往来运送必经之地，我在怀柔的产业还不少，若要细数还真说不上来。」
他在怀里摸索了一下，又拿出那块铁牌，递到温柔手里。「总之这铁牌代表的是东家，旗下产业不认得我的，就认铁牌。你若有想买的东西，尽可以拿这块铁牌去试试，应该可以在不少地方白吃白喝。」
「瞧你得意的！」温柔皱了皱鼻子。「说不定我去的第一间就落了空，还得麻烦你崔大老板拿出银两来。」
她那带着挑衅的小眼神让崔静言眼泛笑意，余光瞥了下这条街上的店面，不敢说自信满满，但也有相当的底气说道：「你不试怎么知道？」
这下温柔可和他杠上了，她站在街道中央，认真打量着周围的铺子。布庄很可疑，首饰店八成是他的，杂货行货源来自大江南北，很像他会做的生意，还有车行……她居然在马车厢上看到了与铁牌上一样的花纹！
温柔开始不淡定了，她总觉得不管自己选了哪家店铺，最终的结果就是又让崔静言嚣张一回。
张望了一圈后，她猛地灵机一动，向崔静言送上一个不服输的眼神，她突然拿着铁牌走向路边卖糖葫芦的小贩。
「这位小哥，来一支糖葫芦。」温柔拿着铁牌朝那小贩晃了晃。「一支多少钱？」
那小贩原本还呆了一下，突然瞪着温柔手上的铁牌，小心翼翼地看了老半天，在温柔猝不及防的时候，把手上插满糖葫芦的草靶子塞进温柔手中。
「这一支，不用钱！」说完，那小贩居然兴冲冲地跑了，留下直接傻在原地的温柔。
崔静言在后头看得好笑，慢条斯理的行来，由温柔手上的草靶子抽出一支糖葫芦，咬了一口后笑道：「柔柔可服了？」
「你……」温柔表情难解地看着他，谁来和她解释一下，这男人都开天香酒楼了，还插手人家卖糖葫芦的生意做什么？或许他之所以能致富，就是脑子和她这种平常人生得不太一样吧？

「我服了。」温柔当真哭笑不得，把铁牌还给他后，赌气似的取了一支糖葫芦大口吃完，其他的全散给路边的乞儿。
content_en:
"What about me?" Wen Wenwen asked urgently. If this man dared to leave her behind again, she would never pay attention to him again.
Cui Jingyan held her hand, which made Wen Li's eyes almost bulge out of his head. He almost couldn't help but reach out to slap her hand away.
"Of course you and I will rush back to the capital first." He winked at her suggestively and smiled ambiguously. "Yangjiagou, you still have to lead the troops for me!"
Chapter 12: The dust settles and you get a reward (1)
In fact, most of Cui Jingyan's wounds have been closed, but there is some blood deficiency. However, he is in good health, and as a man, he recovers quickly from blood deficiency, so after negotiating with Wen Li about returning to Beijing, he and Wen Wen set off back to Beijing.
On this journey, they left Miyunnan and went down to Huairou, then from Huairou to Shunyi, and then took a boat from Tongzhou back to the capital. This was the most convenient way. If the speed was fast, it would take about a little more than half a month. However, in the middle they would take a detour to Yangjiagou to lead the troops, a place full of deep love between the two of them, where a thousand days of raising troops was finally spent.
Two days after setting off, the two first arrived in Huairou County. This is a warm and humid place, and the snow will stop falling here. Huairou's mountains gradually decrease from north to south, with mountains, hills, and plains arranged in an orderly manner. This unique condition makes the place rich in products. In addition, it is not too far from Beijing. During the period close to the New Year, the county town has a market for several days in a row. People come and go on the streets, and the traffic is busy, which is quite lively.
Wen Wen always thought that traveling back to King Qin in Beijing would be difficult, and she was mentally prepared. Unexpectedly, being with Cui Jingyan completely subverted her imagination.
As soon as he arrived in Huairou County, he first took Wenrou to the largest inn in the area, "Yunlailou". Yunlai Building is a three-story building with a vast area. It has an independent courtyard and clean single rooms to satisfy guests from all walks of life who want to stay in top-notch accommodation.
Wen Wen didn't expect that Cui Jingyan would book the most gorgeous courtyard in Yunlai Building as soon as he made the move. When the shopkeeper personally took them in, they looked around and saw the garden with stacked rocks and exquisite architecture. The courtyard facing them was a five-bay courtyard with three pavilions. There was also a double-story building behind it, facing the mountains and deep waters in the north of the county town, where they could enjoy the scenery.
She looked a little puzzled and said: "You don't have to enjoy it like this, right? I thought we were on the road and just slept for one night and just had a small single room. Living here would be too luxurious and wasteful..."
Wen Li's house in Gubeikou is not even one-tenth as gorgeous as this small courtyard.
Cui Jing smiled silently and took out an iron plate for the shopkeeper to inspect. The shopkeeper then returned it respectfully and personally provided warm water cloths for the guests to clean, as well as a pair of comfortable cloth-covered soft-soled shoes for each person. Tea and snacks were placed on the coffee table, and the sandalwood stove was lit before politely leaving.
This made Wen Wen dumbfounded, thinking that Yun Lailou was too considerate. Living in the most expensive courtyard, the shopkeeper personally entertained her and did everything.
At this time, Cui Jingyan said leisurely: "Yunlai Building is my husband's property. No matter how long we live there, it won't cost any money. So it would be a waste if we don't live here."
Wen Wen suddenly realized it and couldn't help but feel funny. "That's true. I forgot that besides being a county king, my husband is also a wealthy businessman. What does it mean to live in a small courtyard on his own property?"
The two of them only rested in the yard for a while, and then Cui Jingyan took Wenwen out to eat. In order to let her taste the most authentic taste, he specially took her out of Yunlailou and entered the famous Tianxiang Restaurant in the county.
Tianxiang Restaurant is only half a quarter of an hour away from Yunlai Tower. Cui Jingyan also asked for the largest private room. There was a double-sided embroidered screen from the south of the Yangtze River. The golden nanmu Duobao was decorated with precious white porcelain. A large table that could seat fifteen people only occupied Wen Wen and Cui Jingyan, which made her suddenly have the illusion that she was a wealthy person.
Not long after, the waiter came in to deliver the meal, including steamed rainbow trout, crispy sturgeon, roast duck, lamb scorpion, chestnut braised pork, shredded smoked rabbit, and tofu stewed in Baihe.Fish, crystal hooves... Fifteen dishes were placed on the table, not counting desserts and soups. Wen Wenwen was dazzled by the sight and didn't know how to start.
She was just about to say that she didn't need to order so many dishes, when she saw Cui Jingyan took out the iron plate again and asked the restaurant owner who personally delivered the last dish to check. The owner then sent a pot of osmanthus wine, saying that it was only for distinguished guests and was not generally sold to the public.
Wen Wen seemed to have seen something, and asked with a smile: "Is this also your husband's property?"
"Exactly." Cui Jingyan slowly put away the iron plate and personally served a bowl of tofu and white river fish for Wen Wen. "So you don't have to worry about the price. You can eat whatever you want. It's up to you to eat and drink from one plate to another."
After all, the dishes were served, and Wen Wenwen would not be polite to him. After feasting, she still had time to think about it. It turned out that she was a young lady from a rich family. It seemed that marrying him would really make a lot of money.
The feast was a feast for both the guests and the host. Wen Wen felt that the food was almost piled on top of his head and the leather belt around his waist was about to break.
Cui Jingyan simply took her for a walk on the street to eat, watching the people busy doing New Year shopping. It was not as cold and windy as Gubeikou here. Gentle just felt extremely leisurely, so comfortable that she almost squinted her eyes.
"If dad knew we were traveling like this, he would probably scold me for being an unworthy woman." Wen Wen suddenly chuckled. This was probably the most bizarre rush march she had ever experienced. She had good food and sleep, all expenses were free, and she still had time to go shopping.
"I can pass on the order. If the mighty Marquis comes, all the bills will be put on my head. I'm afraid dad won't even come into my property, let alone spend money like water." Cui Jingyan sighed lightly, actually looking pity.
"That's right." Wen Wen suddenly looked back with a narrow expression. "How big is your business? Which stores do you own in Huairou? I'll have to talk to my dad later and ask him to join the big business."
Cui Jingyan was startled when she heard this, and then showed a thoughtful expression. "Because this place happens to be between the border and the capital, and it is a must-go place for goods to be transported. I have quite a lot of properties in Huairou, and I really can't tell you how to count them in detail."
He fumbled around in his arms, took out the iron plate, and handed it to Wen Wenwen. "In short, this iron sign represents the owner. If the properties under its control don't recognize me, they will recognize the iron sign. If you have something you want to buy, you can try this iron sign. You should be able to eat and drink for free in many places."
"Look how proud you are!" Wenwen wrinkled her nose. "Maybe the first one I go to will fail, and I'll have to trouble you, Boss Cui, to come up with some silver."
Her provocative little eyes made Cui Jingyan smile. He glanced at the storefronts on this street. He didn't dare to say that he was confident, but he was quite confident and said, "How will you know if you don't try?"
This time Wen Wenwen came into contact with him. She stood in the middle of the street and carefully looked at the shops around her. The cloth store was very suspicious, the jewelry store was probably his, the grocery store's supplies came from all over the country, it was very similar to the kind of business he would do, and there was also a car dealership... She actually saw the same pattern on the carriage as on the iron plate!
Wen Wen began to lose her composure. She always felt that no matter which store she chose, the final result would be to make Cui Jingyan arrogant again.
After looking around, she suddenly had an idea and gave Cui Jingyan a look of reluctance. She suddenly walked towards the roadside vendor selling candied haws with an iron sign.
"Brother, please bring me a candied haws." Rouwen waved the iron sign towards the vendor. "How much does one cost?"
The hawker was stunned for a moment, then suddenly stared at the iron sign in Wen Wen's hand, carefully looking at it for a long time. When Wen Wen was caught off guard, he put the grass target filled with candied haws in Wen Wen's hand.
"This one costs nothing!" After saying that, the vendor ran away happily, leaving Wen Wenwen stunned on the spot.
Cui Jingyan looked at it funny from behind, slowlyActing in an orderly manner, he took out a candied haws from the straw target in Rourou's hand, took a bite and said with a smile, "Is Rourou ready?"
"You..." Wen Wen looked at him with a puzzled expression. Who can explain to her that this man already owns Tianxiang Restaurant, so why is he intervening in other people's business of selling candied haws? Maybe the reason why he became rich was because his brain was different from an ordinary person like her?
"I'm convinced." Wen Wen was really dumbfounded. After returning the iron plate to him, she took out a candied haws and ate it in a big gulp, and scattered the rest to the beggars on the roadside.
